result.instructions: Tools for Localazy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects do I have, and which files are in my app project?"; "Show the French translations of the strings in my main app file."; "What machine translation suggestions exist for the string 'Add to cart' in German?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Localazy data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run localazy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run localazy_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run localazy_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. localazy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: localazy_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the Localazy projects the token can reach (a project token reaches one project): id, slug, name, source language, your role and visibility. Optionally add owning-organization limits (keys used/available, feature flags) and per-language progress counts (active, review, current, translated, sourceChanged, needImprovement). GET /projects.

organization.description: Add the owning organization's key usage and feature flags.

tools.name: localazy_list_import_formats
tools.title: List import file types
tools.description: List the file types Localazy can store strings as (type id, name, support for plurals/arrays/structured keys). The `json` type is what localazy_import_keys uses. GET /import/formats.

tools.name: localazy_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List the files in a project (id, name, type, optional path). Use a file id with localazy_get_file_keys to read its strings. GET /projects/{projectId}/files.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

tools.name: localazy_get_file_keys
tools.title: Get file keys and translations
tools.description: Read the strings of one file in one language: key id, key path, current translation (a string, an array or a plural object keyed @one/@other). Pages of up to 1000 keys; pass `next` for the following page. Set extra_info for hidden/limit/deprecated/comment, no_content to list keys without text. Counts against the project's daily fetch cap. GET /projects/{projectId}/files/{fileId}/keys/{lang}.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, cs, pt_BR, zh#Hans (as listed with localazy_list_projects languages=true).

limit.description: Items per page, 1-1000 (default 100 for keys; Localazy's own default for links is 1000).

next.description: Paging key: pass the previous reply's `next`. Absent `next` = last page.

extra_info.description: Add hidden, limit, deprecated and comment to each key.

unapproved.description: Include translations that are not yet approved.

tools.name: localazy_list_key_links
tools.title: List key links (duplicities)
tools.description: List links between duplicate source keys (key id, linked project id, linked key id), paged. Needs the Reviewer role. GET /projects/{projectId}/links.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

limit.description: Items per page, 1-1000 (default 100 for keys; Localazy's own default for links is 1000).

next.description: Paging key: pass the previous reply's `next`. Absent `next` = last page.

tools.name: localazy_list_cdn_metadata
tools.title: List CDN metadata files
tools.description: List the Localazy CDN release tags of a project and the URL of each tag's metadata file (languages, plural rules). Needs the Manager role. GET /projects/{projectId}/cdn.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

tools.name: localazy_get_import_progress
tools.title: Get import progress
tools.description: Progress of an import batch started with localazy_import_keys (pass its `import_batch`). The endpoint is used by Localazy's own API client but is not in the public docs yet, so the reply is returned as Localazy sends it. GET /projects/{projectId}/import/{importBatch}.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

tools.name: localazy_get_tm_suggestions
tools.title: Get translation memory suggestions
tools.description: Translation Memory suggestions for one source key into a target language: earlier translations of the same text, with the project they came from. Free; no Localazy credits. GET /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}/suggestions/tm.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

key_id.description: Source key id (the `id` of a key from localazy_get_file_keys).

from.description: Source language code (default: the project's source language).

tools.name: localazy_get_mt_suggestions
tools.title: Get machine translation suggestions
tools.description: Machine Translation suggestions (one per engine) for one source key into a target language. Free: it does not consume Localazy credits (Localazy AI does; see localazy_translate_with_ai). The first request for a key can be slower. Nothing is saved. GET /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}/suggestions/mt.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

key_id.description: Source key id (the `id` of a key from localazy_get_file_keys).

from.description: Source language code (default: the project's source language).

tools.name: localazy_list_glossary
tools.title: List glossary terms
tools.description: All glossary terms of a project: id, description, translate/case-sensitive/exact-match flags and the term in each language. GET /projects/{projectId}/glossary.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

tools.name: localazy_get_glossary_term
tools.title: Get glossary term
tools.description: One glossary term by id. GET /projects/{projectId}/glossary/{id}.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

tools.name: localazy_create_glossary_term
tools.title: Create glossary term
tools.description: WRITE: add one term to a project's glossary (max 1,000 terms per project). Needs the Reviewer role. The term guides translators and Localazy AI from now on. POST /projects/{projectId}/glossary.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, cs, pt_BR, zh#Hans (as listed with localazy_list_projects languages=true).

term.description: The term in each language: [{lang, term}]. Include the project's source language.

translate_term.description: true = the term is translated; false = keep it as is in every language.

exact_match.description: Match the exact form only (no inflected forms).

tools.name: localazy_update_glossary_term
tools.title: Update glossary term
tools.description: WRITE: replace the content of one glossary term (the term list and any flags you pass overwrite the old values). Needs the Reviewer role. Read the term first with localazy_get_glossary_term. PUT /projects/{projectId}/glossary/{id}.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, cs, pt_BR, zh#Hans (as listed with localazy_list_projects languages=true).

term.description: The term in each language: [{lang, term}]. Include the project's source language.

translate_term.description: true = the term is translated; false = keep it as is in every language.

exact_match.description: Match the exact form only (no inflected forms).

tools.name: localazy_submit_translation
tools.title: Submit a translation
tools.description: WRITE: set the translation of ONE source key in ONE target language. Reviewers, managers, owners and trusted translators set it as the current version (it overwrites the existing translation and goes live in the next download/CDN release); a translator's value is stored as a candidate for review. Values are stored as-is, with no placeholder, plural or length check, and the source language cannot be written. Check the reply's `stored`. POST /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}/translations/{lang}.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

key_id.description: Source key id (the `id` of a key from localazy_get_file_keys).

lang.description: Target language code (not the source language).

value.description: The translation: a string for a singular key, an array of strings for an array key, or an object keyed by plural form (zero, one, two, few, many, other; the @one/@other form that localazy_get_file_keys returns is accepted too) for a plural key, with at least one form. It must match the key's form.

tools.name: localazy_import_keys
tools.title: Import a few keys
tools.description: WRITE: add or update up to 50 string keys in ONE file, in ONE language (flat key -> text; use a key like "home.title" for the key name). Needs the Owner role. Nothing is deleted or deprecated, and Localazy does not overwrite existing current translations by default (translations identical to the source are skipped). By default the language is the project's source language, so this adds new source keys or changes the source text of existing ones (which marks their translations as changed); pass a different language to import translations, optionally through review with import_as_new. Imports count against the project's daily import cap (Free plan: 100/day). Returns an import_batch id for localazy_get_import_progress. POST /projects/{projectId}/import.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

language.description: Language of the strings in `keys`, e.g. en. Use the project's source language to add source keys.

file_name.description: Target file name in the project (default content.json). A new name creates a new file.

file_path.description: Optional path of the file in the project, without the file name.

import_as_new.description: Send the imported translations through the review process (recommended for translations you are unsure about).

tools.name: localazy_update_key_properties
tools.title: Update key comment/limit/visibility
tools.description: WRITE: change a source key's translator comment, maximum translation length, or hidden flag (fields you omit stay as they are). Needs the Manager role. It does not change texts and cannot deprecate or delete the key. PUT /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

key_id.description: Source key id (the `id` of a key from localazy_get_file_keys).

limit.description: Maximum translation length; -1 removes the limit.

tools.name: localazy_translate_with_ai
tools.title: Translate texts with Localazy AI (spends credits)
tools.description: COSTS CREDITS: translate up to 10 texts with Localazy AI. Every call consumes Localazy credits from the account balance, by the number of translated words (see localazy.com/pricing); nothing is stored in the project, the translations are only returned. Limits: 10 requests/minute, 32 items and 16,384 characters per request. Beta. Needs the Owner role. POST /projects/{projectId}/ai.

project.description: Localazy project id or slug (from localazy_list_projects).

source.description: Text, or an object of plural forms.

fallback.description: Engine to use when Localazy AI is unavailable.

annotations.title: Translate texts with Localazy AI (spends credits)
